learning_outcomes.text: Acquires knowledge about high voltage power transmission lines. Comprehends insulation studies carried out against high voltage.
Comprehends breakdown phenomena in different electrode systems and learns their calculations. Can generate high voltage.

syllabus_topics: General information about high voltage, high voltage power transmission lines
Breakdown phenomena in planar electrode systems
Breakdown phenomena in spherical electrode systems
Breakdown phenomena in cylindrical electrode systems
High voltage overhead line cables and supporting poles
Earthing systems, lightning and lightning protection
Schwarz transformation, graphical and experimental methods
